business_summary: Harima B.Stem Corporation provides building maintenance and management services in Japan. The company offers daily and regular cleaning, floor cleaning, stripping, wax, waste management, infection control cleaning/disinfection, robots cleaning services, as well as glass, exterior wall, and lighting fixture cleaning services; facility management services comprising electrical equipment, air conditioning equipment, water supply and drainage sanitary equipment management, and grease trap cleaning; security services consisting of patrol work, entry and exit management operations, facility security services, parking lot management services, traffic guidance and crowd control security work, crime and disaster prevention, facility security operations, traffic guidance and crowd control security work, and parking lot management; and environmental sanitation and health law inspection services. It also provides restaurant and cafeteria operations, room maintenance work, reception and public relations, information and telephone exchange services; inspection, construction, and maintenance of water supply and drainage sanitary, air conditioning, electrical, building, and fire protection and safety equipment; and patrol inspection services, as well as operates a 24-hour equipment emergency center. In addition, the company engages in public-private partnership and private finance initiative projects for art museums, government buildings-related, cultural and educational, sports, and other facilities. Further, it provides virus and mold prevention solutions, such as high-power UV germicidal lamps. Harima B.Stem Corporation was incorporated in 1961 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.
business_summary_ko: Harima B.Stem Corporation은 일본에서 건물 유지 관리 및 관리 서비스를 제공합니다. 이 회사는 일일 및 정기 청소, 바닥 청소, 스트립 제거, 왁스, 폐기물 관리, 감염 관리 청소/소독, 로봇 청소 서비스는 물론 유리, 외벽 및 조명기구 청소 서비스도 제공합니다. 전기 장비, 공조 장비, 급수 및 배수 위생 장비 관리, 그리스 트랩 청소로 구성된 시설 관리 서비스; 순찰업무, 출입관리업무, 시설보안업무, 주차장관리업무, 교통안내 및 군중통제 보안업무, 범죄 및 방재업무, 시설보안업무, 교통안내 및 군중통제 보안업무, 주차장관리 등으로 구성된 보안업무 환경 위생 및 보건법 검사 서비스. 또한 레스토랑 및 카페테리아 운영, 객실 유지 관리 작업, 리셉션 및 홍보, 정보 및 전화 교환 서비스를 제공합니다. 상하수도 위생, 공조, 전기, 건축, 소방 및 안전시설의 검사, 시공, 유지관리
